name: agentpane
description: A side pane for Claude Code that lists the subagents a session runs, what each is doing and what it costs in tokens, with each one's conversation a click away.

autoOpen.title: Open by itself
autoOpen.description: Open the pane when an agent starts

foldAfter.title: Fold after (seconds)
foldAfter.description: Fold the pane this many seconds after the last agent finishes; 0 keeps it open

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Animate the spinner and the shimmer on running agents

keepFinished.title: Finished agents listed
keepFinished.description: How many finished agents the list keeps (1-30)

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show the running agents under the prompt while the pane is not on screen
